meta.audit_note: Reality-check performed during PR copilot/update-module-transaction-documentation (2026-04-10). All primary docs verified against source files in src/transaction/ and include/transaction/.

missing_implementations.title: TransactionAuditor — exportToKafka / exportToS3 sind Stubs
missing_implementations.expected: exportToKafka() exportiert Audit-Log-Einträge an einen Kafka-Topic; exportToS3() lädt in S3-kompatiblen Speicher hoch
missing_implementations.observed: Beide Methoden geben Status::Error('not yet implemented') zurück; keine echte Verbindung zu Kafka oder S3

evidence.stub_lines: lines 98–109 (exportToKafka: not yet implemented, exportToS3: not yet implemented)

missing_implementations.title: SnapshotManager::serialize/deserialize — kein Cross-Shard-Import-Pfad
missing_implementations.claim_source: include/transaction/ROADMAP.md Planned Features §Cross-shard read snapshot export
missing_implementations.expected: serialize()/deserialize() erlauben Transport eines Snapshot auf Remote-Shard via RPC für globally consistent read replicas
missing_implementations.observed: serialize()/deserialize() sind lokal implementiert (include/transaction/snapshot_manager.h:273–278); kein RPC-Transport oder Remote-Import-Pfad vorhanden
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [transaction] Wire SnapshotManager serialize/deserialize to cross-shard RPC import

missing_implementations.title: SagaOrchestrator — kein Async/Coroutine-Step-Dispatch
missing_implementations.claim_source: include/transaction/ROADMAP.md Planned Features §Async saga step execution
missing_implementations.claim_section: Async saga step execution in SagaOrchestrator (Target: Q3 2026)
missing_implementations.expected: co_await-basierter Step-Dispatch; C++20 Coroutinen für asynchrone Saga-Steps
missing_implementations.observed: SAGAStep::forward und compensate sind std::function<void()>; keine Coroutinen-Unterstützung in saga_orchestrator.h/cpp

evidence.stub_lines: SAGAStep::forward = std::function<void()>; no co_await, no coroutine_handle

missing_implementations.roadmap_marker: [ ] Async saga step execution in SagaOrchestrator (Target: Q3 2026)

summary.note: Alle wesentlichen Features des Transaktions-Moduls (2PC, SAGA, OCC, SSI, Savepoints, Deadlock-Prävention, Write-Batching, Audit-Trail) sind vollständig implementiert und production-ready. Offene Punkte betreffen ausschließlich explizit dokumentierte Stubs oder zukünftig geplante Features.
